sender.sr: Sajt koji liči na poznatu prodavnicu ili brend, često preko reklame na mrežama
sender.en: A site that looks like a well-known shop or brand, often via a social media ad

name.sr: Lažna internet prodavnica: veliki popust, platite karticom, roba ne stiže
name.en: Fake online shop: big discount, pay by card, nothing arrives

how.sr: Reklama ili link vodi na sajt koji izgleda kao prodavnica poznatog brenda, a adresa se razlikuje za jedno slovo, ili na prodavnicu sa neverovatno niskim cenama (klima uređaji, obuća, elektronika). Plaćate karticom unapred. Roba ne stiže, a sa kartice se kasnije skidaju i drugi iznosi.
how.en: An ad or link leads to a site that looks like a well-known brand’s shop with an address one letter off, or to a shop with unbelievably low prices (air conditioners, shoes, electronics). You pay by card in advance. Nothing arrives, and more charges later appear on the card.

text.en: An ad with a big discount.

text.sr: Sajt sa adresom koja liči na pravu.
text.en: A site with an address that looks like the real one.

text.sr: RASPRODAJA ZALIHA: inverter klima 12000 BTU sa montažom samo 19.990 din! Ostalo još 7 komada, akcija važi do ponoći. Poruči odmah: [link]
text.en: STOCK CLEARANCE: 12000 BTU inverter air conditioner with installation for just 19,990 dinars! Only 7 left, offer ends at midnight. Order now: [link]

sr: naručio preko sajta roba nije stigla
lažni sajt poznatog brenda popust kartica
sajt liči na pravu prodavnicu jedno slovo razlike
posle kupovine na sajtu skidaju novac sa kartice
en: ordered from a website nothing arrived
site looks like real shop one letter different
after buying on site money taken from card

sr: Adresa sajta se razlikuje od zvanične za slovo ili nastavak.
Samo plaćanje karticom unapred, bez pouzeća.
Nema podataka o firmi, PIB-a ni adrese.
en: The site address differs from the official one by a letter or ending.
Only card payment in advance, no cash on delivery.
No company details, tax ID or address.

sr: Proverite adresu sajta i podatke o prodavcu pre kupovine. Za internet koristite posebnu karticu sa limitom.
Ako ste platili, odmah zovite banku i tražite blokadu i povraćaj.
Lažnu prodavnicu prijavite na Sajber straži.
en: Check the site address and seller details before buying. Use a separate, limited card online.
If you paid, call your bank at once and ask for a block and a chargeback.
Report the fake shop on Sajber straža.
